name: clinica-x
description: Monorepo Clínica X — Microservicios con Arquitectura Hexagonal + DDD

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names services,ai,frontend --prefix-colors cyan,green,blue "pnpm dev:services" "pnpm dev:ai" "pnpm dev:frontend"
scripts.prisma:generate:all: pnpm --filter auth-service prisma:generate && pnpm --filter appointment-service prisma:generate && pnpm --filter clinical-service prisma:generate && pnpm --filter file-service prisma:generate && pnpm --filter ocr-service prisma:generate
scripts.prisma:migrate:all: pnpm --filter auth-service prisma:migrate && pnpm --filter appointment-service prisma:migrate && pnpm --filter clinical-service prisma:migrate && pnpm --filter file-service prisma:migrate
scripts.seed:all: pnpm --filter auth-service seed && pnpm --filter appointment-service seed && node scripts/seed-demo.js
